text: Lol looks like my ass is falling out of my jeans here but also im sitting through the chair [Image #2]
resolution: Fixed the crooked sit: deriveSeatFromFaces was reading faces.find(bodyPart) — only the FIRST tagged face of each body part. The user's sculpted backrest is several faces, so one off-center strip's centroid set the facing and skewed the whole pose. Now it aggregates the COMBINED centroid of EVERY face per tag (seat/back/head/legs), so a wide or multi-face backrest yields a centered, un-crooked facing; the seat packing axis also moved from per-edge (which assumed a single quad) to an X/Z bounding box over all seat verts, robust to a many-face curved seat. seating 9/9 and cook 26/26 hold. seating.ts hot-reloads, so the user re-tests by reloading the preview in rjit dev; the live look (crooked gone) is theirs to confirm.
